scope: Step 5 follow-up required by the frozen liq-glm prereg after an INCONCLUSIVE_NUMERICAL_INSTABILITY verdict. Diagnostics only; no new gate is declared here.

concentration.note: BTC+ETH dominate events and notional; per-coin reporting mandatory. No PASS may be driven by BTC/ETH alone.

extrapolation.interpretation: The instability is confined to test block 3 (2025-09-29..2025-10-28, the Oct-2025 funding spike). Raw funding/premium/ema_dist fall outside the training range there, so the log-link linear predictor extrapolates.

label_ceiling.note: Observed liquidation labels do not exist before 2025-05-25. The 2024-08..2025-04 4h-candle/funding extension is therefore structurally impossible for an observed-label test; do not fabricate or proxy it.

power_assessment.verdict: ADEQUATE for a 9-coin panel; every block has >= 246 positive days. Power is not the binding constraint.
power_assessment.subcohort_note: BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, DOGE carry 94.2% of events. A frozen top-5 sub-cohort would be adequately powered but more BTC/ETH-concentrated; not preferred over the full 9-coin panel.

binding_constraint: Out-of-range extrapolation of raw funding/premium/ema_dist in test block 3, not sample size or label availability.

recommended_next_campaign.rationale: The only failure is bounded-feature extrapolation in one block. Re-specify the SAME Poisson/quasi-Poisson log-link GLM with each continuous feature clipped to the training [min, max] (frozen from train only) before fitting. This is a materially different estimator, so it requires a new frozen prereg before any outcome.
recommended_next_campaign.transform: For fundingRate, abs_fund_pct, premium, ema_dist: clip to the training-set observed [min, max] computed on positive-t1_liq train rows; then standardize by the training mean/std. RV log features unchanged. No outcome-dependent tuning.
recommended_next_campaign.splits: identical to the sealed 134503Z layout (train 2025-05-25..2025-06-30; test blocks 0-3).
recommended_next_campaign.acceptance: Same gate: >=2% relative QLIKE reduction AND 95% CI upper < 0 AND >=5 instruments AND >=3 blocks AND Holm across the family AND no single-coin driver; max row QLIKE <= 1e6 required for a non-inconclusive verdict.
recommended_next_campaign.if_again_inconclusive: Emit a timestamped evidenced structural-blocker document with the exact failing minima and stop; do not iterate on estimator forms without a materially new source or a new preregistered design.
